phrase: an attic where the moths keep the hours

raw_result.description: The shelves are no taller than a child, and every book is small enough to hold in one hand. Moths rest on the spines like bookmarks, their wings folded gently against the paper. When the lantern flickers, they lift all at once and settle again, each on the book it loves.
